disagreements.their_reason: A matched-question comparison could show a gap over 0.15; the zero-shot and trained arms use differently sized populations (609 versus 77), so this is not ruled out.
Case-level controlled variation could make count more predictive than maximum cosine; correlations across aggregated cells with coupled manipulations do not rule that out.
The gap could resume falling beyond 18 aliases; no measurement beyond 18 rules this out, so the claimed permanent capability residual is unsupported.
Prompt overlap or non-concentrated instability would falsify it; the supplied artifact omits attack-run details and its 0-versus-6 quorum statement cannot support claims unique to verification.

0.reason: A changed fitted-artifact fingerprint after append would falsify it; all three fingerprints remain byte-identical.

1.reason: Entity exceeding relation penalty, or depth-2 falling below 0.10, would falsify it; measured penalties rule both out.

2.reason: Any refused case not becoming correct, or any fingerprint changing, would falsify it; 432/432 transition and identical hashes rule this out.

3.reason: Staleness exceeding refusal or other wrong answers would falsify it; old->old is 1 versus 150 refusals and 82 other answers.

4.reason: No breakage reduction on the same 431 cases would falsify it; downstream supply reduces breakage from 0.274 to 0.077.

5.reason: A depth-2 held-out gap beyond 0.02 would falsify the scoped parity claim; the measured gap is +0.011.

6.reason: Within the stated corpus, model-only planning matching the walker or store-filtered planning missing it would falsify the claim; neither occurs.

7.reason: A matched-question comparison could show a gap over 0.15; the zero-shot and trained arms use differently sized populations (609 versus 77), so this is not ruled out.

8.reason: Higher wrongness or refusal gains smaller than correct-answer losses would falsify it; both depths reduce wrongness and the 0.643 refusal gain exceeds either loss.

9.reason: Case-level controlled variation could make count more predictive than maximum cosine; correlations across aggregated cells with coupled manipulations do not rule that out.

10.reason: A wrongness increase comparable to the answering gain, or disappearance of refusal loss after matched tuning, would falsify it; matched coverage shows +0.0723 versus +0.7407 and large refusal losses.

11.reason: The gap could resume falling beyond 18 aliases; no measurement beyond 18 rules this out, so the claimed permanent capability residual is unsupported.

12.reason: Prompt overlap or non-concentrated instability would falsify it; the supplied artifact omits attack-run details and its 0-versus-6 quorum statement cannot support claims unique to verification.

13.reason: A head gap above 0.05 on any scoped population would falsify it; measured gaps are 0.029, 0.010, and 0.001, while retrieval drops sharply.
